retrieval_path: MemorySystem.retrieve (http:http://127.0.0.1:8700, policy memory-bank:fixed-evidence), one retrieval per question and policy shared by every arm

qa.reader_prompt: LongMemEval step-by-step reading prompt, sessions in date order

versions.vendor_benchmark_code: vectorize-io/agent-memory-benchmark@f618ed7b1f0eb9cad7b42e876f91a42f0eadb150 (src/memory_bench/memory/hindsight.py, provider hindsight-http; the ref memory-bank's own hindsight-system-evals runs, AMB_REF=main); vectorize-io/hindsight-benchmarks@55c51f1d6e2477ee69c0a730a80b96a1596ff475 benchmarks the extraction LLM directly, not server ingestion, so it is not used

recipe.notes: Documented self-hosted install (docker/docker-compose/external-pg: server image + pgvector). Every value is the server default at v0.10.2: config.py DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER='openai', PROVIDER_DEFAULT_MODELS['openai']='gpt-4o-mini', DEFAULT_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER='local' with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION=384), DEFAULT_RERANKER_PROVIDER='local' with cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2. One LLM serves every role (retain, reflect, consolidation); only retain runs here. Embedding and reranking make no provider calls.

common.settings: HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_MODEL=gpt-4.1-mini; HINDSIGHT_API_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=openai, HINDSIGHT_API_EMBEDDINGS_OPENAI_MODEL=text-embedding-3-large, HINDSIGHT_API_EMBEDDINGS_OPENAI_DIMENSIONS=1536 (sent as the API's dimensions parameter, engine/embeddings.py)
common.notes: The reranker is outside the common contract and stays at the recipe's local cross-encoder.

capabilities.time_notes: retain item `timestamp` = session event_time (AMB passes Document.timestamp the same way); recall `query_timestamp` = query_time, the anchor for relative dates and recency. An event_time or query_time without a UTC offset is read as UTC.
capabilities.granularity: one retain item per session (content = JSON of the session's turns, as AMB serializes LoCoMo and LongMemEval sessions), document_id = source_id

provenance.mechanism: every recall result carries `document_id`, which is the source_id the shim passed to retain; a chunk item takes the document_id of the fact that cites it. Observations (consolidated facts) would carry no document_id and report unavailable, but they are disabled per bank (see deviations).

capabilities.delete_notes: DocumentsApi.delete_document(bank, document_id): deletes the document and every memory unit and link extracted from it in one transaction, and invalidates observations built on them (memory_engine.py delete_document). Re-retaining the same document_id replaces it (update_mode default 'replace').
capabilities.readiness: retain is submitted with retain_async=true (as AMB does); /ingest polls OperationsApi.get_operation_status until completed or failed and then reads DocumentsApi.get_document().memory_unit_count; /finish polls OperationsApi.list_operations totals until in_flight = total - completed - failed is 0 (AMB `_in_flight_ops`), failed > 0 => degraded

vendor-default.notes: hindsight-client 0.10.2 `recall` defaults (hindsight_client.py:618-639): token-budgeted, not top-k. budget mid, max_tokens 4096 of fact text, chunks off, entities off, all fact types. query_timestamp is always the question date.

fixed-evidence.notes: Same call with the fact-token cap raised to the shootout's 8,000-token evidence budget, so the harness packer, not memory-bank's 4,096 cap, decides what fits. memory-bank counts tokens with its own tokenizer, the harness with approxTokens; the packer truncates.

vendor_benchmark_reference.notes: What AMB's memory-bank provider sends for LoCoMo (`_recall_kwargs`); BEAM uses max_tokens 12288 and max_chunk_tokens 8192. Recorded for reference, not a shootout policy.

retrieval_policies.item_mapping: recall results in memory-bank's rank order: world and experience facts -> type fact, observations -> type observation, text = AMB `_format_result` ('**[type]** text' plus an occurred/mentioned line); with include_chunks, each chunk follows the first fact that cites it as a type chunk item (AMB inlines it there). valid_from/valid_to stay null: occurred_start/occurred_end are when an event happened, not a validity window, so they live in the text.

deviations_from_vendor_code: No raw dataset ids anywhere: AMB sets document_id and metadata.doc_id to '<sample_id>_<session>' and context to '... (session_N of conv-26)' or 'Session <question_id>_<session_id> ...'; the shim sends document_id = opaque source_id, no metadata at all (metadata influences extraction), and context = 'Conversation between <speakers>'.
No per-user tags: AMB tags items 'user:<id>' when it shares one bank; the shim uses one bank per namespace, which AMB also does in per-unit mode.
Turns are serialized as the harness sends them ({role, speaker, content}) instead of the dataset's own JSON keys (LoCoMo {speaker, dia_id, text}, LongMemEval {role, content}).
One retain request per session, waited on before the next session, instead of AMB's async batches of 20 items; ordering and per-session receipts follow the shootout's ingestion contract.
No retries: AMB retries failed submissions and failed operations up to 5 times; the shim reports a failed operation as a degraded session and the harness accounts for it.
Retrieval amount follows the shootout's two policies (client defaults, and an 8,000-token cap) rather than AMB's per-dataset recall settings, which are recorded under vendor_benchmark_reference.

Observations off in both configs: enable_observations=false per bank, as AMB's `_bank_kwargs` sets for every dataset, memory-bank's own benchmark setting. The server default (DEFAULT_ENABLE_OBSERVATIONS) is on.
HINDSIGHT_API_SKIP_LLM_VERIFICATION=true, so the server does not spend a provider call checking the key at boot (operational only).
